brief: One original diagonal rocket family with four user-selected glass themes. All four use matching rocket proportions, faint low-contrast glass backgrounds, non-emissive rocket surfaces and no surrounding halo. Ocean is the package default and fallback. No text or watermark.

variants.design: Glass violet: purple non-emissive rocket on pale lavender-white low-contrast glass, with a coral-orange flame and no surrounding halo

Glass blue: deep sapphire non-emissive default rocket on near-white cool-blue low-contrast glass for clear Dock-size separation, using the same soft surface gradient as violet and no surrounding halo; white porthole and warm coral-orange flame
Glass black on bright base: graphite-black non-emissive rocket on pale low-contrast glass, using the same soft surface gradient as violet and no surrounding halo; warm coral-orange flame

Glass white on dark base: pearl-silver non-emissive rocket with a smoked graphite porthole on deep midnight-charcoal low-contrast glass, using the same soft surface gradient as violet and no surrounding halo; warm coral-orange flame
